result.summary: Review of target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (feature/binary-config-serve-20260930), scope: schema/migrations, query indexes, growing events/results/history, pagination cost and retention at scale. Verdict FINDINGS: 2 HIGH, 3 MEDIUM, 3 LOW. HIGH: /metrics render is O(retained workers x retained events) - no index on events(worker_id), per-worker scans plus a json_extract scan per dispatch (metrics.ts:84-127); one render's statement set measured 0.525s at 200 workers/8k events and 27.55s at 800/80k, 150.8ms per worker at 5000 workers/250k events, blocking the single-threaded event loop (serve.ts:178-190). HIGH: Store.tokens() full-scans usage because of the '? IS NULL OR col=?' idiom (store.ts:328) on the 2s poll path (coordinator.ts:614-616) - 7.9ms vs 0.1ms with a plain predicate at 100k usage rows. MEDIUM: worker-filtered event pagination unindexed (store.ts:179; 20.4ms -> 0.2ms after adding events(worker_id,id)); no retention anywhere so history grows forever and store.all()/redactor/list_workers are O(history); completed-dispatch history per worker unbounded and re-parsed on every poll and response. LOW: unused workers_state index; logged_event cursor written per event (FULL sync); no user_version and positional INSERTs break on a future column add. Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md, findings.json; logs /workspace/.swarmforge/logs/rev12-probes.log.
result.details:
Setup: disposable detached clone at /tmp/rev12/repo, git rev-parse HEAD = d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895; assigned /workspace/repo left at baseline 5672ead, clean and unmodified. No source changes, commits, pushes, spawns or config changes.

Findings (file:line at target):
F1 HIGH src/metrics.ts:84 - render() loops every retained worker (store.all(), :74) and per worker runs store.tokens(:84), 'GROUP BY type WHERE worker_id=?'(:100-104), min(at)(:110-115) and one json_extract event scan per dispatch(:121-127); events has no worker_id index so each is SCAN events. Single-threaded Bun process means a scrape stalls MCP tools, the 2s tick and the log flush. Fix: events(worker_id,id)+events(worker_id,type,at) indexes, set-based GROUP BY aggregates or persisted counters, cached snapshot.
F2 HIGH src/store.ts:328 - tokens() nullable-filter idiom yields 'SCAN usage' instead of 'SEARCH usage USING sqlite_autoindex_usage_1'; called every poll per active worker (coordinator.ts:614-616, enabled by default TOKEN_IDLE=300), on claimDispatch (store.ts:261), publicWorker (security.ts:145) and metrics.ts:84. Fix: separate filtered/unfiltered statements.
F3 MEDIUM src/store.ts:179 - events()/lifecycleEvents() worker filter not indexable; get_worker_logs after=0 scans later rows. With events(worker_id,id) added the page fell 20.4ms -> 0.2ms, but the OR-guarded form still chose the rowid seek, so both fixes are needed.
F4 MEDIUM src/store.ts:22 - zero DELETE/prune/retention in src; destroy only transitions to destroyed (coordinator.ts:969); store.all() 5.9ms at 5000 workers twice per tick; redactorFor (security.ts:44-49) rescans 3 variants of every retained worker password per response (13-16ms at 5000 workers); list_workers (mcp.ts:96-113) slices in JS so limit reduces no work. Docs delegate file retention to the operator (OBSERVABILITY.md:30) but ship no pruning hook.
F5 MEDIUM src/store.ts:232 - dispatches()/dispatch()/result() load every dispatch body (results up to 60 KiB); only non-terminal dispatches are capped at 100 (coordinator.ts:215). Measured: dispatch() 8.1ms, result() 8.3ms, list_workers(limit=20) store work 95.2ms at 20 workers x 300 dispatches.
F6 LOW src/store.ts:26 - workers_state index never used; state only filtered in JS; index maintained on every transition.
F7 LOW src/runtime.ts:210 - logged_event cursor persisted per event; Store.setting is its own autocommit txn and synchronous=2 (FULL, measured), up to ~100 fsynced writes/s. Cursor correctness unaffected.
F8 LOW src/store.ts:118 - user_version=0, only CREATE IF NOT EXISTS, positional INSERTs; first future column add breaks retained DBs at runtime. Latent: DDL identical across all commits touching store.ts.

Tests: probes only, all outside the checkout in /tmp/rev12/probe (disclosed); 7 Bun 1.3.14 scripts importing the target's real src/store.ts and src/security.ts without bun install, plus sqlite3 3.45.1 EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN and generated statement batches over synthetic databases built from the target DDL. All exited 0. Repo test suite and bun run check deliberately not run (whole-suite/typecheck roles, and the snapshot Bun cannot read lockfileVersion 2). No cloud/model/infra calls, no .env or secret files read, no credentials in outputs.

Limitations: synthetic data; 5000-worker figures are per-unit measurements extrapolated; repo tests not executed; concurrency effects unmeasured. Token-usage max-upsert semantics, lifecycle races, Git handoff and packaging were treated as other reviewers' scopes.
